How hiring works for employers
From role creation to hire, guided with clarity at every stage.
Create your company profile
Set up your employer presence with key company details.  A clear profile helps candidates understand your organisation and supports stronger engagement from the start.
Post a role with structured details
Add role requirements, location, pay range, and hiring timeline using guided fields designed for alignment. Clear role information helps matching stay focused and relevant.
Receive matched candidates or browse profiles
AI-assisted matching highlights candidates aligned to your role, while profile browsing gives flexibility to explore talent directly. Both paths support informed shortlisting with ease.
Connect and schedule conversations
Review profiles with visible trust signals and reach out through the platform. Built-in tools support smooth communication and interview scheduling.
Confirm hiring and manage outcomes
Move roles from live to filled with full visibility. Hiring activity, conversations, and progress stay organised within your employer dashboard.
How opportunities work for candidates
From profile creation to meaningful work, built around skills, availability, and momentum.
Create your profile
Share your experience, preferences, location, and availability in a structured profile. This information helps employers understand your strengths and connect with purpose.
Upload a CV or build one with smart tools
Upload an existing CV or create one using guided tools designed for clarity and alignment. A structured CV helps your experience stand out clearly.
Complete verification to strengthen visibility
Verification adds trusted signals to your profile and CV. These signals help employers recognise readiness and engage with confidence.
Receive matches aligned to skills and goals
Matches reflect skills, experience, location, availability, and pay expectations. This alignment helps opportunities feel relevant and well-timed.
Connect with employers and move into work
Engage in conversations, attend interviews, and progress into roles that fit your goals. Every step supports forward movement with clarity.
AI matching that supports better decisions
Matching is designed to surface relevance and support confident decisions.
Skills & Experience
Profiles and roles align around capabilities, experience level, and role requirements to support meaningful fit.
Location & Availability
Geography, work preferences, and availability guide alignment to support realistic engagement.
Salary Alignment
Pay expectations help shape matches that feel appropriate and balanced for both sides.
Human Decisions
AI highlights alignment while people guide conversations, decisions, and hiring outcomes.
Verification and badges that build trust
Clear identity verification

HireHub integrates identity verification directly into profiles, helping employers and candidates connect with clarity and assurance. Verified profiles display clear indicators that highlight readiness and authenticity from the first interaction.
Visible badges across profiles and CVs
Badges appear across candidate profiles and CVs, making trust easy to recognise at a glance. They highlight completed verification and achievements that support credibility and professional presence.
Employer-visible ratings
Employer-visible ratings add helpful context after work is completed. These insights support future hiring decisions and help candidates build a trusted track record over time.
Ready to move forward with confidence?

Whether you’re building a team or exploring your next opportunity, HireHub supports
 progress with clarity, speed, and control — all in one place.
